items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: We were like a family. That's why I don't understand why he didn't call here to let me know his mother had passed.

ctx.x: So you made some records, huh? Yeah, I made records with Rudy Blair and Baby Dodge and George Lewis. You known Joey's finished a good while? Oh yes, indeed. We were like a family. That's why I don't understand why he didn't call here to let me know his mother had passed. I know he came here. He said, I wasn't going to leave out of town until I come see you. He said, his mother, every time he got ready to go somewhere to see somebody, she'd make out she's sick. I said, no, George, she's old and she ain't been…

Yeah. My baby used to get him jobs too. He's the one that had the young tuxedo draft. Yeah, uh-huh. Yeah, that's him. When I may see him Tuesday, he's supposed to have a little funeral. Hmm? He's supposed to have a funeral Tuesday. Yeah, why? Up at the merry-go-round, Eagle and Hickory, you know? Oh yeah, you go where up there? Oh, anywhere I go in. I follow my job.
